change.before: "results caching was not enabled by default"
change.after: "results caching for stats, volume, label, and series queries is enabled by default"

consequence.statement: Query results for stats, volume, label, and series requests will now be cached by default to the in-memory results_cache, changing query performance characteristics and memory usage patterns.

assertion.statement: Results caching for 'stats', 'volume', 'label', and 'series' queries in the TSDB index type is now enabled by default, caching to the results_cache configured in the query_range config section using an in-memory cache by default.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key behavior-changed
